verdict.rationale: Whether a robotics fleet platform publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. The only GitHub evidence is the FormantIO/toolkit repo, a developer toolkit for building apps on Formant's APIs, not the platform's or agent's source, and no item names any license. With no evidence that the product's own source is readable under an open license, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
